string.name: desc
string.value: Installs a robot factory that summons toy robots. Summoned robots detect nearby enemies and triggers a self-destruct function. The factory itself also self-destructs after a certain period of time.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, Robot Factory Duration: #time sec, Max Toy Robots Summoned: #y toy robots, Toy Robot Damage: #u%, Summon Interval: every #x sec, Self-Destruct Damage: #selfDestruction%, Cooldown: #cooltime sec
